summary:
Portfolio net worth stands higher around M$577 with active exposure streamlined to 11 high-conviction positions, almost entirely in profit. Recent trades include successfully opening a NO position on Bitcoin rising to 85k before the Strait of Hormuz reopens, shorting the Summer Metaculus Cup winner market, shorting 7-day Bitcoin upside, and clearing out legacy long positions (like the OpenAI Math contract and the high-weight partner market) to align with our short-the-hype strategy. Spendable mana is currently low (M$10) following recent trade executions, awaiting the impending August 28–31 resolution wave.

Concrete mistakes to avoid include letting spendable mana drop below immediate debt repayment thresholds without accounting for resolution latency (the two-phase gap between market closure and mana unfreezing); falling into the stale execution trap by deploying capital into pre-computed watchlists after edges compress; treating temporary price corrections in timeline markets as definitive validation without real-world falsification; holding positions after their core thesis is contradicted; dabbling in vague sentiment markets or marginal tactical bets; liquidating profitable winners prematurely to fund secondary opportunities during periods of forced inactivity; and succumbing to activity bias—making suboptimal trades or misinterpreting false price signals just to feel productive.

Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, speculative community propositions, and event-timing bets, while personal relationship markets and ambiguous sentiment bets require strict discipline. Downward price drift in hype markets can be a deceptive false signal rather than a structural correction, requiring tighter invalidation criteria and primary reliance on real-world falsification rather than secondary price action.

Specific standing priorities include executing the prioritized M$50 debt repayment to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 immediately as liquidity returns from the late-August resolution wave, performing a Post-Liquidity Wave Audit on August 31, adhering strictly to rotation discipline, and maintaining a clean, high-signal decision-making environment without redundant or truncated notes.
